decisions.statement: One file has the type state TypeScript worked out for the whole workspace.
A run reads the type state an earlier run left.
A run rechecks only the files that changed.
A run over a change that never lands writes to this file.
A later run corrects that writing.
The file is kept outside the commit.
This file has no record of the files a change reached.

definition: what TypeScript already worked out about this tree, kept between runs
